construction_rules: Root and owner remain primary identity teachers; external research supplies methods, never private identity labels.
Map all admitted source policies and meaningful exceptions to these objectives; inspect unmapped records rather than dropping them.
Candidate wording and decisive current state vary independently; keep both original and coherent matched teaching.
Include identity-specific motives and asymmetries, not only generally helpful or boundary-respecting answers.
Preserve multiple legitimate actions and interpretations; lower fit is not automatically contraindication.
Review source authority, time, support, disconfirmation and unknowns individually; source-card support lists are not automatic labels.
Existing CAL/FINAL and diagnostic ancestry remain excluded from optimizer additions.
Cover combinations chosen for a real behavioral interaction, without a universal Cartesian-product dataset or fixed row quota.
Integration obligations require the actual cognitive/conversation loop; synthetic examples are not lived outcomes.
Qualitative expressive priors can be taught as explicit policies; numerical acoustics and owner/spoken fidelity require their own legitimate evidence.
Extend compatible learned state under a new admission and explicit successor lineage; do not silently use exact-resume with changed targets.
Counts and coverage mappings do not establish learning; evaluate original failures, correct controls and actual full native outputs.
corpus_breadth_rule: Meaningful source-supported or explicit synthetic branches, contextual exceptions and interactions; counts are not evidence of saturation.
owner_constraints: Root and owner are identity teachers; no external identity teacher
Frozen headless Gemma candidate is not approved N0
Preserve valid learned state; do not routinely remake N1-N3
Practical suppression of established Gemma governing influence; remaining established influence is a defect
